note: Last-known positions from a terrestrial AIS sample (typically within about 200 km of a shore station). Ships far offshore, or silent during this window, keep an older last-known fix or appear as not seen. This run listened for about 11 minutes on three connections: one collecting ship identity data worldwide (filling missing MMSIs from IMO numbers), two cycling through 6 batches of up to 200 fleet MMSIs (20 batch windows of ~80s). Positions are kept for 7 days and shaded by age (older than 6 hours is marked stale); older fixes are listed but not drawn. Not a live feed and not a complete census.
